answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 1190 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is their an islamic basis for rukhsati. Basically I am looking to do my Nikah in the next few days, but the brides family want the bride to stay with the family until after Ramadan. I have two questions. Firstly is this permissable, secondly if we do Nikkah are we allowed to have sexual relations before Rukhsati? Question: Is their an islamic basis for rukhsati. Basically I am looking to do my Nikah in the next few days, but the brides family want the bride to stay with the family until after Ramadan. I have two questions. Firstly is this permissable, secondly if we do Nikkah are we allowed to have sexual relations before Rukhsati? Answer ID: 1190 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 762/762=J) Rukhsati is not necessary just after Nikah . Hazrat Ali (Raziallahu Anhu) was married to Hazrat Fatimah (Raziallahu Anha) in 1 Hijra year while the Rukhsati took place in 2 Hijra after the Battle of Badr . ( Isabah , Biography of Hazrat Fatimah ) (2) It is allowed to have sexual relation after Nikah before Rukhsati as the rule of Shariah , but this is not considered good in society; therefore you are suggested to avoid having sexual relation before Rukhsati . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
